@concat('" SELECT DISTINCT ''DTL'' AS DETAIL,NULL AS BGBG_ID,NULL AS BGBG_NAME, SBSB.SBSB_CK,SBSB.SBSB_ID,MEME.MEME_BIRTH_DT,SBSD.SBSD_MCTR_STYP,
  MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT,MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT,
  GRGR.GRGR_ID,MEPE.CSCS_ID,MEPE.CSPI_ID,SBAD.SBAD_TYPE,NULL AS ASM,
  SBAD.SBAD_ADDR1  AS ADDR1,
  SBAD.SBAD_ADDR2  AS ADDR2,
  SBAD.SBAD_ADDR3  AS ADDR3,
  SBAD.SBAD_CITY   AS CITY,
  SBAD.SBAD_STATE  AS STATE,
  SBAD.SBAD_ZIP    AS ZIP,
  		 CASE WHEN SUBSTR(GRGR.GRGR_ID,1,2) IN (''GA'',''NY'') THEN 
			    					TO_CHAR(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM TO_DATE(''"', string(variables('BatchDt')), ''',''mm/dd/yyyy'')+60)=1 THEN TO_DATE(''', string(variables('BatchDt')), '"'',''mm/dd/yyyy'')+60 
			 							ELSE TO_DATE(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(''"', string(variables('BatchDt')), ''',''mm/dd/yyyy'')+60,1))||''/''||''01''||''/''||EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(''', string(variables('BatchDt')), '"'',''mm/dd/yyyy'')+60,1)),''MM/DD/YYYY'') END ,''YYYYMMDD'')			 
       WHEN SUBSTR(GRGR.GRGR_ID,1,2) =''NV'' THEN TO_CHAR(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM TO_DATE(''"', string(variables('BatchDt')), ''',''mm/dd/yyyy'')+67)=1 THEN TO_DATE(''', string(variables('BatchDt')), '"'',''mm/dd/yyyy'')+67 
			 							ELSE TO_DATE(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(''"', string(variables('BatchDt')), ''',''mm/dd/yyyy'')+67,1))||''/''||''01''||''/''||EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(''', string(variables('BatchDt')), '"'',''mm/dd/yyyy'')+67,1)),''MM/DD/YYYY'') END ,''YYYYMMDD'')			  
       WHEN SUBSTR(GRGR.GRGR_ID,3,6) =''SUP000'' THEN TO_CHAR(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM TO_DATE(''"', string(variables('BatchDt')), ''',''mm/dd/yyyy'')+67)=1 THEN TO_DATE(''', string(variables('BatchDt')), '"'',''mm/dd/yyyy'')+67 
			 							ELSE TO_DATE(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(''"', string(variables('BatchDt')), ''',''mm/dd/yyyy'')+67,1))||''/''||''01''||''/''||EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(''', string(variables('BatchDt')), '"'',''mm/dd/yyyy'')+67,1)),''MM/DD/YYYY'') END ,''YYYYMMDD'')			 
       ELSE TO_CHAR(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM TO_DATE(''"', string(variables('BatchDt')), ''',''mm/dd/yyyy'')+30)=1 THEN TO_DATE(''', string(variables('BatchDt')), '"'',''mm/dd/yyyy'')+30 
			 							ELSE TO_DATE(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(''"', string(variables('BatchDt')), ''',''mm/dd/yyyy'')+30,1))||''/''||''01''||''/''||EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(''', string(variables('BatchDt')), '"'',''mm/dd/yyyy'')+30,1)),''MM/DD/YYYY'') END ,''YYYYMMDD'')			 
        END AS PREM_RATE_START_DT,
  CASE WHEN MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT-1 =  (SELECT MEPE_TERM_DT FROM FACETS.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG WHERE MEPE.MEME_CK = MEME_CK AND MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND = ''Y'' AND TO_DATE(''"', string(variables('BatchDt')), '"'',''mm/dd/yyyy'') BETWEEN MEPE_EFF_DT AND MEPE_TERM_DT) 
       THEN ''N'' ELSE ''Y'' END AS NEW_ENROLL,PLDS.PLDS_DESC,
MEME.MEME_FIRST_NAME,MEME.MEME_LAST_NAME, MEME.MEME_MID_INIT,''AREIN'' AS LETTER_TYPE,NULL AS CSPI,NULL AS PDRC
,SBRT.SBRT_RT_AREA
FROM
  FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB
  INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME
    ON MEME.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK AND SBSB.SBSB_ID  IN (SELECT DISTINCT SUBSCRIBER_ID FROM AGP.AUTO_TERM_DELINQNT_REINSTMNT)
  INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR
    ON GRGR.GRGR_CK = SBSB.GRGR_CK
  INNER JOIN (  SELECT GRGR_ID AS GRGR_ID, CASE WHEN SUBSTR(GRGR_ID,1,2) IN (''GA'',''NY'') THEN  CASE WHEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM TO_DATE(''"', string(variables('BatchDt')), ''',''mm/dd/yyyy'')+60)=1 THEN TO_DATE(''', string(variables('BatchDt')), '"'',''mm/dd/yyyy'')+60 
			 							ELSE TO_DATE(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(''"', string(variables('BatchDt')), ''',''mm/dd/yyyy'')+60,1))||''/''||''01''||''/''||EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(''', string(variables('BatchDt')), '"'',''mm/dd/yyyy'')+60,1)),''MM/DD/YYYY'') END 
       WHEN SUBSTR(GRGR_ID,1,2) =''NV'' THEN CASE WHEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM TO_DATE(''"', string(variables('BatchDt')), ''',''mm/dd/yyyy'')+67)=1 THEN TO_DATE(''', string(variables('BatchDt')), '"'',''mm/dd/yyyy'')+67 
			 							ELSE TO_DATE(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(''"', string(variables('BatchDt')), ''',''mm/dd/yyyy'')+67,1))||''/''||''01''||''/''||EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(''', string(variables('BatchDt')), '"'',''mm/dd/yyyy'')+67,1)),''MM/DD/YYYY'') END
       WHEN SUBSTR(GRGR_ID,3,6) =''SUP000'' THEN CASE WHEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM TO_DATE(''"', string(variables('BatchDt')), ''',''mm/dd/yyyy'')+67)=1 THEN TO_DATE(''', string(variables('BatchDt')), '"'',''mm/dd/yyyy'')+67 
			 							ELSE TO_DATE(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(''"', string(variables('BatchDt')), ''',''mm/dd/yyyy'')+67,1))||''/''||''01''||''/''||EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(''', string(variables('BatchDt')), '"'',''mm/dd/yyyy'')+67,1)),''MM/DD/YYYY'') END
       ELSE CASE WHEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM TO_DATE(''"', string(variables('BatchDt')), ''',''mm/dd/yyyy'')+30)=1 THEN TO_DATE(''', string(variables('BatchDt')), '"'',''mm/dd/yyyy'')+30 
			 							ELSE TO_DATE(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(''"', string(variables('BatchDt')), ''',''mm/dd/yyyy'')+30,1))||''/''||''01''||''/''||EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(''', string(variables('BatchDt')), '"'',''mm/dd/yyyy'')+30,1)),''MM/DD/YYYY'') END END
       AS DT
      FROM FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP) DT ON DT.GRGR_ID = GRGR.GRGR_ID
  INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG MEPE
    ON MEME.MEME_CK = MEPE.MEME_CK
   
    AND  DT.DT BETWEEN MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT AND MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT
  INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSD_SPLT_DTL SBSD
    ON SBSD.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK  
  INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI 
    ON BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK 
       AND BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = ''I'' 
  INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBAD_ADDR SBAD
    ON SBAD.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK 
    AND SBSB.SBAD_TYPE_MAIL = SBAD.SBAD_TYPE
  INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_PLDS_PLAN_DESC PLDS 
   ON  MEPE.CSPI_ID=PLDS.CSPI_ID      
  LEFT OUTER JOIN 
            (
            SELECT
            DISTINCT
            SBSB_CK
            ,SBRT_EFF_DT
            /*OVERLAPPING SBRT PERIOD IS CONVERTED TO NON OVER LAPPING*/          
             ,CASE 
            WHEN SBRT_TERM_DT_2 IS NULL THEN SBRT_TERM_DT
            WHEN SBRT_TERM_DT < SBRT_TERM_DT_2 THEN SBRT_TERM_DT
            ELSE SBRT_TERM_DT_2
            END AS SBRT_TERM_DT
            ,SBRT_SMOKER_IND
            ,SBRT_RT_AREA
            FROM
            (
            SELECT /*+ INDEX_FFS(SRT) NO_BATCH_TABLE_ACCESS_BY_ROWID(SRT)*/
            DISTINCT 
            SBSB_CK
            ,SBRT_EFF_DT
            ,SBRT_TERM_DT
            ,CASE WHEN SBRT_SMOKER_IND IS NULL THEN ''N'' ELSE SBRT_SMOKER_IND END AS SBRT_SMOKER_IND
            ,SBRT_RT_AREA
            ,CASE 
            WHEN  SBRT_TERM_DT = LEAD(SBRT_EFF_DT-1) OVER(PARTITION BY SBSB_CK ORDER BY SBRT_EFF_DT, SBRT_TERM_DT) THEN SBRT_TERM_DT 
            ELSE LEAD(SBRT_EFF_DT-1) OVER(PARTITION BY SBSB_CK ORDER BY SBRT_EFF_DT, SBRT_TERM_DT) 
            END AS SBRT_TERM_DT_2
            FROM FACETS.CMC_SBRT_RATE_DATA SRT
            ) SRM
            ) SBRT
            ON SBRT.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK 
            AND
            CASE 
            /* 1 DENOTES OVERLAPPING PERIODS, 0 DENOTES EXCLUSIVE PERIODS */
            WHEN (MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT < SBRT.SBRT_EFF_DT) THEN 0
            WHEN (MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT = SBRT.SBRT_EFF_DT) THEN 0
            WHEN (MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT < SBRT.SBRT_EFF_DT AND MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT > SBRT.SBRT_EFF_DT AND MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT < SBRT.SBRT_TERM_DT) THEN 1
            WHEN (MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT < SBRT.SBRT_EFF_DT AND MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT = SBRT.SBRT_TERM_DT) THEN 1
            WHEN (MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT < SBRT.SBRT_EFF_DT AND MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT > SBRT.SBRT_TERM_DT) THEN 1
            WHEN (MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT = SBRT.SBRT_EFF_DT AND MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT < SBRT.SBRT_TERM_DT) THEN 1
            WHEN (MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT = SBRT.SBRT_EFF_DT AND MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT = SBRT.SBRT_TERM_DT) THEN 1
            WHEN (MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT = SBRT.SBRT_EFF_DT AND MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT > SBRT.SBRT_TERM_DT) THEN 1
            WHEN (MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT > SBRT.SBRT_EFF_DT AND MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT < SBRT.SBRT_TERM_DT) THEN 1
            WHEN (MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT > SBRT.SBRT_EFF_DT AND MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT = SBRT.SBRT_TERM_DT) THEN 1
            WHEN (MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT > SBRT.SBRT_EFF_DT AND MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT < SBRT.SBRT_TERM_DT AND MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT > SBRT.SBRT_TERM_DT) THEN 1
            WHEN (MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT = SBRT.SBRT_TERM_DT) THEN 0
            WHEN (MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT > SBRT.SBRT_TERM_DT) THEN 0
            END = 1
  WHERE GRGR.GRGR_ID LIKE ''%SUP%'' AND SBSD_MCTR_STYP NOT IN (''EMPL'',''FAML'')"')

  SBAD.SBAD_ADDR1  AS ADDR1,
  SBAD.SBAD_ADDR2  AS ADDR2,
  SBAD.SBAD_ADDR3  AS ADDR3,
  SBAD.SBAD_CITY   AS CITY,

  SBAD.SBAD_ZIP    AS ZIP,

       WHEN SUBSTR(GRGR.GRGR_ID,1,2) =''NV'' THEN TO_CHAR(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM TO_DATE(''"', string(variables('PreviousDt')), ''',''mm/dd/yyyy'')+67)=1 THEN TO_DATE(''', string(variables('PreviousDt')), '"'',''mm/dd/yyyy'')+67 
			 							ELSE TO_DATE(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(''"', string(variables('PreviousDt')), ''',''mm/dd/yyyy'')+67,1))||''/''||''01''||''/''||EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(''', string(variables('PreviousDt')), '"'',''mm/dd/yyyy'')+67,1)),''MM/DD/YYYY'') END ,''YYYYMMDD'')			  
       WHEN SUBSTR(GRGR.GRGR_ID,3,6) =''SUP000'' THEN TO_CHAR(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM TO_DATE(''"', string(variables('PreviousDt')), ''',''mm/dd/yyyy'')+67)=1 THEN TO_DATE(''', string(variables('PreviousDt')), '"'',''mm/dd/yyyy'')+67 
			 							ELSE TO_DATE(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(''"', string(variables('PreviousDt')), ''',''mm/dd/yyyy'')+67,1))||''/''||''01''||''/''||EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(''', string(variables('PreviousDt')), '"'',''mm/dd/yyyy'')+67,1)),''MM/DD/YYYY'') END ,''YYYYMMDD'')			 
       ELSE TO_CHAR(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM TO_DATE(''"', string(variables('PreviousDt')), ''',''mm/dd/yyyy'')+30)=1 THEN TO_DATE(''', string(variables('PreviousDt')), '"'',''mm/dd/yyyy'')+30 
			 							ELSE TO_DATE(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(''"', string(variables('PreviousDt')), ''',''mm/dd/yyyy'')+30,1))||''/''||''01''||''/''||EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(''', string(variables('PreviousDt')), '"'',''mm/dd/yyyy'')+30,1)),''MM/DD/YYYY'') END ,''YYYYMMDD'')			 
        END AS PREM_RATE_START_DT,
  CASE WHEN MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT-1 =  (SELECT MEPE_TERM_DT FROM FACETS.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG WHERE MEPE.MEME_CK = MEME_CK AND MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND = ''Y'' AND TO_DATE(''"', string(variables('PreviousDt')), '"'',''mm/dd/yyyy'') BETWEEN MEPE_EFF_DT AND MEPE_TERM_DT) 
       THEN ''N'' ELSE ''Y'' END AS NEW_ENROLL,PLDS.PLDS_DESC,
MEME.MEME_FIRST_NAME,MEME.MEME_LAST_NAME, MEME.MEME_MID_INIT,''AREIN'' AS LETTER_TYPE,NULL AS CSPI,NULL AS PDRC,SBRT.SBRT_RT_AREA FROM
  FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB
  INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME
    ON MEME.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK AND SBSB.SBSB_ID  IN (SELECT DISTINCT SUBSCRIBER_ID FROM AGP.AUTO_TERM_DELINQNT_REINSTMNT)
  INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR
    ON GRGR.GRGR_CK = SBSB.GRGR_CK
  INNER JOIN (  SELECT GRGR_ID AS GRGR_ID, CASE WHEN SUBSTR(GRGR_ID,1,2) IN (''GA'',''NY'') THEN  CASE WHEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM TO_DATE(''"', string(variables('PreviousDt')), ''',''mm/dd/yyyy'')+60)=1 THEN TO_DATE(''', string(variables('PreviousDt')), '"'',''mm/dd/yyyy'')+60 
			 							ELSE TO_DATE(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(''"', string(variables('PreviousDt')), ''',''mm/dd/yyyy'')+60,1))||''/''||''01''||''/''||EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(''', string(variables('PreviousDt')), '"'',''mm/dd/yyyy'')+60,1)),''MM/DD/YYYY'') END 
       WHEN SUBSTR(GRGR_ID,1,2) =''NV'' THEN CASE WHEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM TO_DATE(''"', string(variables('PreviousDt')), ''',''mm/dd/yyyy'')+67)=1 THEN TO_DATE(''', string(variables('PreviousDt')), '"'',''mm/dd/yyyy'')+67 
			 							ELSE TO_DATE(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(''"', string(variables('PreviousDt')), ''',''mm/dd/yyyy'')+67,1))||''/''||''01''||''/''||EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(''', string(variables('PreviousDt')), '"'',''mm/dd/yyyy'')+67,1)),''MM/DD/YYYY'') END
       WHEN SUBSTR(GRGR_ID,3,6) =''SUP000'' THEN CASE WHEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM TO_DATE(''"', string(variables('PreviousDt')), ''',''mm/dd/yyyy'')+67)=1 THEN TO_DATE(''', string(variables('PreviousDt')), '"'',''mm/dd/yyyy'')+67 
			 							ELSE TO_DATE(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(''"', string(variables('PreviousDt')), ''',''mm/dd/yyyy'')+67,1))||''/''||''01''||''/''||EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(''', string(variables('PreviousDt')), '"'',''mm/dd/yyyy'')+67,1)),''MM/DD/YYYY'') END

			 							ELSE TO_DATE(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(''"', string(variables('PreviousDt')), ''',''mm/dd/yyyy'')+30,1))||''/''||''01''||''/''||EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(''', string(variables('PreviousDt')), '"'',''mm/dd/yyyy'')+30,1)),''MM/DD/YYYY'') END END
       AS DT
      FROM FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP) DT ON DT.GRGR_ID = GRGR.GRGR_ID
  INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG MEPE
    ON MEME.MEME_CK = MEPE.MEME_CK
   
    AND  DT.DT BETWEEN MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT AND MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT
  INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSD_SPLT_DTL SBSD

  INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBAD_ADDR SBAD

   LEFT OUTER JOIN 
            (
            SELECT
            DISTINCT
            SBSB_CK
            ,SBRT_EFF_DT
           /* OVERLAPPING SBRT PERIOD IS CONVERTED TO NON OVER LAPPING */
            ,CASE 
            WHEN SBRT_TERM_DT_2 IS NULL THEN SBRT_TERM_DT
            WHEN SBRT_TERM_DT < SBRT_TERM_DT_2 THEN SBRT_TERM_DT
            ELSE SBRT_TERM_DT_2
            END AS SBRT_TERM_DT
            ,SBRT_SMOKER_IND
            ,SBRT_RT_AREA
            FROM
            (
            SELECT /*+ INDEX_FFS(SRT) NO_BATCH_TABLE_ACCESS_BY_ROWID(SRT)*/
            DISTINCT 
            SBSB_CK
            ,SBRT_EFF_DT
            ,SBRT_TERM_DT
            ,CASE WHEN SBRT_SMOKER_IND IS NULL THEN ''N'' ELSE SBRT_SMOKER_IND END AS SBRT_SMOKER_IND
            ,SBRT_RT_AREA
            ,CASE 
            WHEN  SBRT_TERM_DT = LEAD(SBRT_EFF_DT-1) OVER(PARTITION BY SBSB_CK ORDER BY SBRT_EFF_DT, SBRT_TERM_DT) THEN SBRT_TERM_DT 
            ELSE LEAD(SBRT_EFF_DT-1) OVER(PARTITION BY SBSB_CK ORDER BY SBRT_EFF_DT, SBRT_TERM_DT) 
            END AS SBRT_TERM_DT_2
            FROM FACETS.CMC_SBRT_RATE_DATA SRT

            ON SBRT.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK

            WHEN (MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT > SBRT.SBRT_EFF_DT AND MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT < SBRT.SBRT_TERM_DT) THEN 1

                 THEN TO_DATE(BLDF.BLDF_SYNC_MO||''/''||''01''||''/''||EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(''"', string(variables('BatchDt')), '"'',''mm/dd/yyyy'')) ,''MM/DD/YYYY'')
            ELSE CASE WHEN ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(BLDF.BLDF_SYNC_MO||''/''||''01''||''/''||EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(''"', string(variables('BatchDt')), '"'',''mm/dd/yyyy'')) ,''MM/DD/YYYY''),3)>=DT.DT 
                          THEN ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(BLDF.BLDF_SYNC_MO||''/''||''01''||''/''||EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(''"', string(variables('BatchDt')), '"'',''mm/dd/yyyy'')) ,''MM/DD/YYYY''),3)
                      ELSE CASE WHEN ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(BLDF.BLDF_SYNC_MO||''/''||''01''||''/''||EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(''"', string(variables('BatchDt')), '"'',''mm/dd/yyyy'')) ,''MM/DD/YYYY''),6)>=DT.DT 
                                   THEN ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(BLDF.BLDF_SYNC_MO||''/''||''01''||''/''||EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(''"', string(variables('BatchDt')), '"'',''mm/dd/yyyy'')) ,''MM/DD/YYYY''),6)
                           ELSE CASE WHEN ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(BLDF.BLDF_SYNC_MO||''/''||''01''||''/''||EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(''"', string(variables('BatchDt')), '"'',''mm/dd/yyyy'')) ,''MM/DD/YYYY''),9)>=DT.DT 
                                   THEN ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(BLDF.BLDF_SYNC_MO||''/''||''01''||''/''||EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(''"', string(variables('BatchDt')), '"'',''mm/dd/yyyy'')) ,''MM/DD/YYYY''),9)
                                ELSE CASE WHEN ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(BLDF.BLDF_SYNC_MO||''/''||''01''||''/''||EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(''"', string(variables('BatchDt')), '"'',''mm/dd/yyyy'')) ,''MM/DD/YYYY''),12)>=DT.DT 
                                         THEN ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(BLDF.BLDF_SYNC_MO||''/''||''01''||''/''||EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(''"', string(variables('BatchDt')), '"'',''mm/dd/yyyy'')) ,''MM/DD/YYYY''),12)
                                     END
                                END     
                           END                                                         
                      END
                 END  
   END    
   WHEN CSPI.CSPI_AGE_CALC_METH = ''E'' THEN 
   CASE 
          WHEN TO_DATE(TRUNC(CSPI.CSPI_REN_BEG_MMDD_NVL/100) || ''/01/'' || (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(''"', string(variables('BatchDt')), '"'',''mm/dd/yyyy''))), ''mm/dd/yyyy'')<TRUNC(DT.DT) 
          THEN TO_DATE(TRUNC(CSPI.CSPI_REN_BEG_MMDD_NVL/100) || ''/01/'' || (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(''"', string(variables('BatchDt')), '"'',''mm/dd/yyyy''))+1), ''mm/dd/yyyy'')
          ELSE TO_DATE(TRUNC(CSPI.CSPI_REN_BEG_MMDD_NVL/100) || ''/01/'' || (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(''"', string(variables('BatchDt')), '"'',''mm/dd/yyyy''))), ''mm/dd/yyyy'')  
        END
   
   END AS PREM_RATE_CURRENT_DT
 FROM
  FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB
  INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME
    ON MEME.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK 
  INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR
    ON GRGR.GRGR_CK = SBSB.GRGR_CK AND (GRGR_ID LIKE ''%SUP000'' OR GRGR.GRGR_ID IN (''COSUPWP0'',''NVSUPWP0'',''WISUPWP0''))
  INNER JOIN (  SELECT GRGR_ID AS GRGR_ID, CASE WHEN SUBSTR(GRGR_ID,1,2) =''NV'' THEN CASE WHEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM TO_DATE(''"', string(variables('BatchDt')), ''',''mm/dd/yyyy'')+67)=1 THEN TO_DATE(''', string(variables('BatchDt')), '"'',''mm/dd/yyyy'')+67 
                                         ELSE TO_DATE(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(''"', string(variables('BatchDt')), ''',''mm/dd/yyyy'')+67,1))||''/''||''01''||''/''||EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(''', string(variables('BatchDt')), '"'',''mm/dd/yyyy'')+67,1)),''MM/DD/YYYY'') END
       WHEN SUBSTR(GRGR_ID,3,6) =''SUP000'' THEN CASE WHEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM TO_DATE(''"', string(variables('BatchDt')), ''',''mm/dd/yyyy'')+67)=1 THEN TO_DATE(''', string(variables('BatchDt')), '"'',''mm/dd/yyyy'')+67 
                                         ELSE TO_DATE(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(''"', string(variables('BatchDt')), ''',''mm/dd/yyyy'')+67,1))||''/''||''01''||''/''||EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(''', string(variables('BatchDt')), '"'',''mm/dd/yyyy'')+67,1)),''MM/DD/YYYY'') END
       ELSE CASE WHEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM TO_DATE(''"', string(variables('BatchDt')), ''',''mm/dd/yyyy'')+30)=1 THEN TO_DATE(''', string(variables('BatchDt')), '"'',''mm/dd/yyyy'')+30 
                                         ELSE TO_DATE(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(''"', string(variables('BatchDt')), ''',''mm/dd/yyyy'')+30,1))||''/''||''01''||''/''||EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(''', string(variables('BatchDt')), '"'',''mm/dd/yyyy'')+30,1)),''MM/DD/YYYY'') END END
       AS DT
      FROM FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP) DT ON DT.GRGR_ID = GRGR.GRGR_ID
  INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG MEPE
    ON MEME.MEME_CK = MEPE.MEME_CK
    AND MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND = ''Y''
    AND  DT.DT BETWEEN MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT AND MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT
  INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSD_SPLT_DTL SBSD  ON SBSD.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK  
  INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI 
    ON BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK 
       AND BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = ''I'' 
  INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBAD_ADDR SBAD 
    ON SBAD.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK 
    AND SBSB.SBAD_TYPE_MAIL = SBAD.SBAD_TYPE
  INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_PLDS_PLAN_DESC PLDS 
   ON  MEPE.CSPI_ID=PLDS.CSPI_ID  
  INNER JOIN CMC_CSPI_CS_PLAN CSPI 
   ON CSPI.GRGR_CK = GRGR.GRGR_CK AND CSPI.CSPI_ID = PLDS.CSPI_ID AND DT.DT BETWEEN CSPI.CSPI_EFF_DT AND CSPI.CSPI_TERM_DT    
    AND CSPI.CSPI_AGE_CALC_METH IN (''E'',''G'')
  INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLDF_BL_DEFINE BLDF 
    ON BLDF.BLEI_CK = BLEI.BLEI_CK AND DT.DT BETWEEN BLDF.BLDF_EFF_DT AND BLDF.BLDF_TERM_DT
  WHERE GRGR.GRGR_ID LIKE ''%SUP%'' AND SBSD_MCTR_STYP NOT IN (''EMPL'',''FAML'') )
SELECT DISTINCT SBSB_ID,PREM_RATE_CURRENT_DT,ADD_MONTHS(PREM_RATE_CURRENT_DT,-1) AS PREM_RATE_PREV_DT,
CASE WHEN CSPI.CSPI_AGE_CALC_METH =''E'' 
   THEN CASE 
          WHEN TO_DATE(TRUNC(CSPI.CSPI_REN_BEG_MMDD_NVL/100) || ''/01/'' || (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(''"', string(variables('BatchDt')), '"'',''mm/dd/yyyy''))), ''mm/dd/yyyy'')<TRUNC(C.PREM_RATE_CURRENT_DT) 
          THEN TO_DATE(TRUNC(CSPI.CSPI_REN_BEG_MMDD_NVL/100) || ''/01/'' || (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(''"', string(variables('BatchDt')), '"'',''mm/dd/yyyy''))+1), ''mm/dd/yyyy'')
          ELSE TO_DATE(TRUNC(CSPI.CSPI_REN_BEG_MMDD_NVL/100) || ''/01/'' || (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(''"', string(variables('BatchDt')), '"'',''mm/dd/yyyy''))), ''mm/dd/yyyy'')  
        END
   WHEN CSPI.CSPI_AGE_CALC_METH =''G''
   THEN CASE 
          WHEN TO_DATE(TRUNC(CSPI.CSPI_OPEN_BEG_MMDD/100) || ''/01/'' || (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(''"', string(variables('BatchDt')), '"'',''mm/dd/yyyy''))), ''mm/dd/yyyy'')<TRUNC(C.PREM_RATE_CURRENT_DT) 
          THEN TO_DATE(TRUNC(CSPI.CSPI_OPEN_BEG_MMDD/100) || ''/01/'' || (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(''"', string(variables('BatchDt')), '"'',''mm/dd/yyyy''))+1), ''mm/dd/yyyy'')
          ELSE TO_DATE(TRUNC(CSPI.CSPI_OPEN_BEG_MMDD/100) || ''/01/'' || (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(''"', string(variables('BatchDt')), '"'',''mm/dd/yyyy''))), ''mm/dd/yyyy'') END END AS CSPI_RENEW_DT,TRUNC(PDRC.PDRC_EFF_DT) AS PDRC_EFF_DT
FROM CTE C
INNER JOIN CMC_CSPI_CS_PLAN CSPI 
   ON CSPI.GRGR_CK = C.GRGR_CK AND CSPI.CSPI_ID = C.CSPI_ID AND C.PREM_RATE_CURRENT_DT BETWEEN CSPI.CSPI_EFF_DT AND CSPI.CSPI_TERM_DT    
    AND CSPI.CSPI_AGE_CALC_METH IN (''E'',''G'') 
  INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_PDRT_RATE_TBL PDRT 
   ON PDRT.PDRT_MODIFIER = C.GRGR_ID||C.CSCS_ID|| C.CSPI_ID 
     AND C.PREM_RATE_CURRENT_DT BETWEEN PDRT.PDRT_EFF_DT AND PDRT.PDRT_TERM_DT
  INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_PDRC_RATE_CAT PDRC 
   ON PDRC.PDRT_CK = PDRT.PDRT_CK
     AND C.PREM_RATE_CURRENT_DT BETWEEN PDRC.PDRC_EFF_DT AND PDRC.PDRC_TERM_DT
WHERE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM C.PREM_RATE_CURRENT_DT) = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM C.DT) 

 "')

@concat('"INSERT INTO AGP.PREM SELECT DISTINCT SBSB.SBSB_ID FROM
  FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB
  INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME
    ON MEME.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK

  INNER JOIN (  SELECT GRGR_ID AS GRGR_ID, CASE WHEN SUBSTR(GRGR_ID,1,2) IN (''GA'',''NY'') THEN  CASE WHEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM TO_DATE(''"', string(variables('BatchDt')), ''',''mm/dd/yyyy'')+60)=1 THEN TO_DATE(''', string(variables('BatchDt')), '"'',''mm/dd/yyyy'')+60 
                                         ELSE TO_DATE(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(''"', string(variables('BatchDt')), ''',''mm/dd/yyyy'')+60,1))||''/''||''01''||''/''||EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(''', string(variables('BatchDt')), '"'',''mm/dd/yyyy'')+60,1)),''MM/DD/YYYY'') END 
       WHEN SUBSTR(GRGR_ID,1,2) =''NV'' THEN CASE WHEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM TO_DATE(''"', string(variables('BatchDt')), ''',''mm/dd/yyyy'')+67)=1 THEN TO_DATE(''', string(variables('BatchDt')), '"'',''mm/dd/yyyy'')+67 
                                         ELSE TO_DATE(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(''"', string(variables('BatchDt')), ''',''mm/dd/yyyy'')+67,1))||''/''||''01''||''/''||EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(''', string(variables('BatchDt')), '"'',''mm/dd/yyyy'')+67,1)),''MM/DD/YYYY'') END
       WHEN SUBSTR(GRGR_ID,3,6) =''SUP000'' THEN CASE WHEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM TO_DATE(''"', string(variables('BatchDt')), ''',''mm/dd/yyyy'')+67)=1 THEN TO_DATE(''', string(variables('BatchDt')), '"'',''mm/dd/yyyy'')+67 
                                         ELSE TO_DATE(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(''"', string(variables('BatchDt')), ''',''mm/dd/yyyy'')+67,1))||''/''||''01''||''/''||EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(''', string(variables('BatchDt')), '"'',''mm/dd/yyyy'')+67,1)),''MM/DD/YYYY'') END
       ELSE CASE WHEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM TO_DATE(''"', string(variables('BatchDt')), ''',''mm/dd/yyyy'')+30)=1 THEN TO_DATE(''', string(variables('BatchDt')), '"'',''mm/dd/yyyy'')+30 
                                         ELSE TO_DATE(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(''"', string(variables('BatchDt')), ''',''mm/dd/yyyy'')+30,1))||''/''||''01''||''/''||EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(''', string(variables('BatchDt')), '"'',''mm/dd/yyyy'')+30,1)),''MM/DD/YYYY'') END END
       AS DT
      FROM FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP) DT ON DT.GRGR_ID = GRGR.GRGR_ID
  INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG MEPE
    ON MEME.MEME_CK = MEPE.MEME_CK
    AND MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND = ''Y''
    AND  DT.DT BETWEEN MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT AND MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT
  INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSD_SPLT_DTL SBSD
    ON SBSD.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK  
  INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI 
    ON BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK 
       AND BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = ''I'' 
  INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBAD_ADDR SBAD
    ON SBAD.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK 
    AND SBSB.SBAD_TYPE_MAIL = SBAD.SBAD_TYPE
  INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_PLDS_PLAN_DESC PLDS 
   ON  MEPE.CSPI_ID=PLDS.CSPI_ID
  INNER JOIN CMC_CSPI_CS_PLAN CSPI    
   ON CSPI.GRGR_CK = GRGR.GRGR_CK    
    AND CSPI.CSPI_ID = PLDS.CSPI_ID AND DT.DT BETWEEN CSPI.CSPI_EFF_DT AND CSPI.CSPI_TERM_DT 
  LEFT JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBRT_RATE_DATA SBRT 
   ON SBRT.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK
    AND DT.DT BETWEEN SBRT.SBRT_EFF_DT AND SBRT.SBRT_TERM_DT        
  WHERE GRGR.GRGR_ID LIKE ''%SUP%'' AND SBSD_MCTR_STYP NOT IN (''EMPL'',''FAML'') AND  DT.DT <> CASE WHEN  SBRT.SBRT_RT_AREA IS NOT NULL AND SBRT.SBRT_RT_AREA IN (''01'',''02'',''03'',''04'',''05'',''06'',''07'',''08'',''09'',''10'',''11'',''12'')
   THEN CASE 
        WHEN TO_DATE(SBRT.SBRT_RT_AREA || ''/01/'' || EXTRACT(YEAR FROM DT.DT), ''mm/dd/yyyy'') < TRUNC(DT.DT) 
        THEN TO_DATE(SBRT.SBRT_RT_AREA || ''/01/'' || (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM DT.DT) + 1), ''mm/dd/yyyy'')
        ELSE TO_DATE(SBRT.SBRT_RT_AREA || ''/01/'' || (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM DT.DT)), ''mm/dd/yyyy'')
     END
   ELSE CASE 
          WHEN TO_DATE(TRUNC(CSPI.CSPI_OPEN_BEG_MMDD/100) || ''/01/'' || (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM DT.DT)), ''mm/dd/yyyy'')<TRUNC(DT.DT) 
          THEN TO_DATE(TRUNC(CSPI.CSPI_OPEN_BEG_MMDD/100) || ''/01/'' || (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM DT.DT)+1), ''mm/dd/yyyy'')
          ELSE TO_DATE(TRUNC(CSPI.CSPI_OPEN_BEG_MMDD/100) || ''/01/'' || (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM DT.DT)), ''mm/dd/yyyy'') END END AND 
   (SBSB.SBSB_CK IN (SELECT DISTINCT SBSR1.SBSB_CK FROM FACETS.CMC_SBSR_SB_RATE SBSR1 LEFT JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSR_SB_RATE SBSR2 ON SBSR1.SBSB_CK = SBSR2.SBSB_CK 
      AND SBSR2.SBSR_TERM_DT=SBSR1.SBSR_EFF_DT-1 AND SBSR2.PDBL_ID NOT IN (''NEWE'',''NEWM'') AND SBSR1.PDBL_ID = SBSR2.PDBL_ID AND SBSR2.SBSR_SB_MOD_AMT<>SBSR1.SBSR_SB_MOD_AMT
WHERE (( SBSR1.PDBL_ID IN (''NEWE'',''HH'',''NEWM'',''QTR'',''ANNU'') ) OR SBSR1.PDBL_ID = ''EFT'')
    AND SBSR1.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK 
    AND SBSR1.SBSR_EFF_DT  BETWEEN DT.DT AND ADD_MONTHS(DT.DT,1)
     
    ) OR BLEI.BLEI_CK IN (SELECT DISTINCT A.BLEI_CK FROM CMC_BLDF_BL_DEFINE A WHERE BLEI.BLEI_CK =A.BLEI_CK AND A.BLDF_EFF_DT >=DT.DT AND A.BLDF_EFF_DT<ADD_MONTHS(DT.DT,1))
    OR SBSB.SBSB_ID IN (SELECT DISTINCT SBSB.SBSB_ID FROM FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB1
  INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME1
    ON MEME1.SBSB_CK = SBSB1.SBSB_CK  
  INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR1
    ON GRGR1.GRGR_CK = SBSB1.GRGR_CK
  INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG MEPE1
    ON MEME1.MEME_CK = MEPE1.MEME_CK
    AND MEPE1.MEPE_ELIG_IND = ''Y''
  WHERE SBSB.SBSB_ID =SBSB1.SBSB_ID AND (GRGR.GRGR_ID<>GRGR1.GRGR_ID OR MEPE.CSCS_ID <> MEPE1.CSCS_ID) AND ADD_MONTHS(DT.DT,-1) BETWEEN MEPE1.MEPE_EFF_DT AND MEPE1.MEPE_TERM_DT ) OR SBSB.SBSB_CK IN 
  (  WITH CT AS  (SELECT DISTINCT SBSR1.SBSB_CK AS SBSB_CK,SBSR1.PDBL_ID AS PDBL_ID,MAX(SBSR1.SBSR_TERM_DT) AS SBSR_TERM_DT FROM FACETS.CMC_SBSR_SB_RATE SBSR1 JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSR_SB_RATE SBSR2 ON SBSR1.SBSB_CK = SBSR2.SBSB_CK AND SBSR1.PDBL_ID = SBSR2.PDBL_ID
    WHERE SBSR1.PDBL_ID IN (''HH'',''EFT'',''QTR'',''ANNU'') AND SBSR2.SBSR_TERM_DT=SBSR1.SBSR_EFF_DT-1 
    GROUP BY SBSR1.SBSB_CK,SBSR1.PDBL_ID ) 
   SELECT DISTINCT SBSR.SBSB_CK FROM FACETS.CMC_SBSR_SB_RATE SBSR JOIN CT C
    ON C.SBSB_CK = SBSR.SBSB_CK AND C.PDBL_ID = SBSR.PDBL_ID 
    WHERE SBSB.SBSB_CK = SBSR.SBSB_CK AND C.SBSR_TERM_DT = DT.DT - 1) OR SBSB.SBSB_CK IN (SELECT DISTINCT SBSR.SBSB_CK FROM FACETS.CMC_SBSR_SB_RATE SBSR
    WHERE SBSR.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK AND SBSR.PDBL_ID IN (''HH'',''EFT'',''QTR'',''ANNU'')
      AND SBSR.SBSR_TERM_DT BETWEEN ADD_MONTHS(DT.DT,-1)AND DT.DT  ))
      
    "')

gv_BLDFGrpQuery.value: 'SELECT    DISTINCT          SBSB.SBSB_CK,SBSB.SBSB_ID, BLDF.BLEI_CK, BLDF.BLDF_EFF_DT, BLDF.BLDF_TERM_DT, BLDF.BLDF_MCTR_STMT, BLDF.SYS_LAST_UPD_DTM  , BGBG.BGBG_ID,SBAD.SBAD_ADDR1,SBAD.SBAD_ADDR2,SBAD.SBAD_CITY,SBAD.SBAD_STATE,SBAD.SBAD_ZIP, BLDF.BLDF_MODE        FROM              FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR              JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB                  on GRGR.GRGR_CK = SBSB.GRGR_CK            JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSD_SPLT_DTL SBSD ON SBSB.SBSB_CK = SBSD.SBSB_CK AND SBSD_MCTR_STYP IN ('EMPL','FAML') AND SBSD_SPLT_PCT = 1000000 JOIN FACETS.CMC_BGBG_BIL_GROUP BGBG ON SBSD.BGBG_CK = BGBG.BGBG_CK JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI on BGBG.BGBG_CK = BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK and BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = 'B' JOIN Facets.CMC_BLDF_BL_DEFINE BLDF                  On BLDF.BLEI_Ck=BLEI.BLEI_CK         JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBAD_ADDR SBAD ON SBAD.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK  AND SBSB.SBAD_TYPE_MAIL = SBAD.SBAD_TYPE  WHERE  GRGR.GRGR_ID LIKE '%SUP%'  '

SBSD.SBSD_MCTR_STYP,        MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT,        MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT,        GRGR.GRGR_ID,        MEPE.CSCS_ID,        MEPE.CSPI_ID,        SBAD.SBAD_TYPE,        NULL AS ASM,        SBAD.SBAD_ADDR1 AS ADDR1,        SBAD.SBAD_ADDR2 AS ADDR2,        SBAD.SBAD_ADDR3 AS ADDR3,        SBAD.SBAD_CITY AS CITY,        SBAD.SBAD_STATE AS STATE,        SBAD.SBAD_ZIP AS ZIP,        TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS (SBSB.SBSB_ORIG_EFF_DT, 6),'YYYYMMDD') AS PREM_RATE_START_DT,        'N' AS NEW_ENROLL,        PLDS.PLDS_DESC,        MEME.MEME_FIRST_NAME,        MEME.MEME_LAST_NAME,        MEME.MEME_MID_INIT,         CASE             WHEN SUBSTR(MEPE.CSPI_ID,4,1) = 'A'             THEN '6MRGAA'             ELSE '6MRG'             END AS LETTER_TYPE,        NULL AS CSPI,        NULL AS PDRC   FROM FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB        INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME ON MEME.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK        INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR ON GRGR.GRGR_CK = SBSB.GRGR_CK        INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG MEPE           ON MEME.MEME_CK = MEPE.MEME_CK AND MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND = 'Y'        INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSD_SPLT_DTL SBSD           ON     SBSD.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK              AND SBSD.SBSD_MCTR_STYP NOT IN ('EMPL', 'FAML')        INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI           ON     BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK              AND BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = 'I'        INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBAD_ADDR SBAD           ON     SBAD.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK              AND SBSB.SBAD_TYPE_MAIL = SBAD.SBAD_TYPE        INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_PLDS_PLAN_DESC PLDS           ON MEPE.CSPI_ID = PLDS.CSPI_ID        INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_CSPI_CS_PLAN CSPI           ON CSPI.GRGR_CK = GRGR.GRGR_CK AND CSPI.CSPI_ID = PLDS.CSPI_ID        INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSR_SB_RATE SBSR ON SBSR.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK        INNER JOIN (SELECT GRGR_ID,                           CASE                              WHEN SUBSTR (GRGR_ID, 1, 2) IN ('GA', 'NY')                              THEN                                 TRUNC (TO_DATE('5/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')) + 65                              WHEN SUBSTR (GRGR_ID, 1, 2) IN ('NV')                              THEN                                 TRUNC (TO_DATE('5/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')) + 72                              WHEN SUBSTR (GRGR_ID, 3, 6) = 'SUP000'                              THEN                                 TRUNC (TO_DATE('5/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')) + 72                              WHEN SUBSTR (GRGR_ID, 1, 2) IN ('CA',                                                              'CO',                                                              'VA',                                                              'WI',                                                              'OH',                                                              'IN',                                                              'KY',                                                              'MO',                                                              'NH',                                                              'CT',                                                              'ME')                              THEN                                 TRUNC (TO_DATE('5/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')) + 35                           END                              AS RateLetterEligibledDt                      FROM FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP) DT           ON DT.GRGR_ID = GRGR.GRGR_ID  WHERE  CSPI.CSPI_GUAR_IND IN ('1', 'F')        AND SBSR.SBSR_EFF_DT >= MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT        AND TO_DATE (TO_CHAR (SBSR.SBSR_TERM_DT, 'MM/DD') || '/2196', 'MM/DD/YYYY') <= MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT        AND SBSR.PDBL_ID IN ('SCHG',                             'NEWE',                             'HH',                             'ANNU',                             'QTR',                             'SEMI',                             'EED')        AND GRGR.GRGR_ID LIKE '%SUP%'        AND DT.RateLetterEligibledDt = ADD_MONTHS (TRUNC (SBSB.SBSB_ORIG_EFF_DT), 6) UNION        SELECT DISTINCT        'DTL' AS DETAIL,        NULL AS BGBG_ID,        NULL AS BGBG_NAME,        SBSB.SBSB_CK,        SBSB.SBSB_ID,        MEME.MEME_BIRTH_DT,        SBSD.SBSD_MCTR_STYP,        MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT,        MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT,        GRGR.GRGR_ID,        MEPE.CSCS_ID,        MEPE.CSPI_ID,        SBAD.SBAD_TYPE,        NULL AS ASM,        SBAD.SBAD_ADDR1 AS ADDR1,        SBAD.SBAD_ADDR2 AS ADDR2,        SBAD.SBAD_ADDR3 AS ADDR3,        SBAD.SBAD_CITY AS CITY,        SBAD.SBAD_STATE AS STATE,        SBAD.SBAD_ZIP AS ZIP,               TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS (SBSB.SBSB_ORIG_EFF_DT, 6),'YYYYMMDD') AS PREM_RATE_START_DT,               'N' AS NEW_ENROLL,        PLDS.PLDS_DESC,        MEME.MEME_FIRST_NAME,        MEME.MEME_LAST_NAME,        MEME.MEME_MID_INIT,         CASE             WHEN SUBSTR(MEPE.CSPI_ID,4,1) = 'A'             THEN '6MRGAA'             ELSE '6MRG'             END AS LETTER_TYPE,        NULL AS CSPI,        NULL AS PDRC   FROM FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB        INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME ON MEME.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK        INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR ON GRGR.GRGR_CK = SBSB.GRGR_CK        INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG MEPE           ON MEME.MEME_CK = MEPE.MEME_CK AND MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND = 'Y'        INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSD_SPLT_DTL SBSD           ON     SBSD.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK              AND SBSD.SBSD_MCTR_STYP NOT IN ('EMPL', 'FAML')        INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI           ON     BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK              AND BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = 'I'        INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBAD_ADDR SBAD           ON     SBAD.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK              AND SBSB.SBAD_TYPE_MAIL = SBAD.SBAD_TYPE        INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_PLDS_PLAN_DESC PLDS           ON MEPE.CSPI_ID = PLDS.CSPI_ID        INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_CSPI_CS_PLAN CSPI           ON CSPI.GRGR_CK = GRGR.GRGR_CK AND CSPI.CSPI_ID = PLDS.CSPI_ID        INNER JOIN (SELECT GRGR_ID,                           CASE                              WHEN SUBSTR (GRGR_ID, 1, 2) IN ('GA', 'NY')                              THEN                                 TRUNC (TO_DATE('5/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')) + 65                              WHEN SUBSTR (GRGR_ID, 1, 2) IN ('NV')                              THEN                                 TRUNC (TO_DATE('5/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')) + 72                              WHEN SUBSTR (GRGR_ID, 3, 6) = 'SUP000'                              THEN                                 TRUNC (TO_DATE('5/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')) + 72                              WHEN SUBSTR (GRGR_ID, 1, 2) IN ('CA',                                                              'CO',                                                              'VA',                                                              'WI',                                                              'OH',                                                              'IN',                                                              'KY',                                                              'MO',                                                              'NH',                                                              'CT',                                                              'ME')                              THEN                                 TRUNC (TO_DATE('5/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')) + 35                           END                              AS RateLetterEligibledDt                      FROM FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP) DT           ON DT.GRGR_ID = GRGR.GRGR_ID  WHERE  CSPI.CSPI_GUAR_IND IN ('1', 'F')             AND GRGR.GRGR_ID LIKE '%SUP%'        AND DT.RateLetterEligibledDt = ADD_MONTHS (TRUNC (SBSB.SBSB_ORIG_EFF_DT), 6)'

gv_SBSRQuery.value: 'select DISTINCT  SBSB.SBSB_ID, SBSR.SBSB_CK, SBSR.SBSR_TYPE, SBSR.PDPD_ID, SBSR.PDBL_ID, SBSR.PDRT_TYPE, SBSR.SBSR_EFF_DT, SBSR.SBSR_TERM_DT, SBSR.SBSR_PREM_SB, SBSR.SBSR_SB_MOD_AMT  FROM FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR	 JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB on GRGR.GRGR_CK = SBSB.GRGR_CK	  JOIN  CMC_SBSR_SB_RATE SBSR ON SBSR.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK   WHERE TO_DATE('5/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')  BETWEEN SBSR.SBSR_EFF_DT AND SBSR.SBSR_TERM_DT  AND GRGR.GRGR_ID LIKE '%SUP%''

gv_BLDFGrpQuery.value: 'SELECT    DISTINCT          SBSB.SBSB_CK,SBSB.SBSB_ID, BLDF.BLEI_CK, BLDF.BLDF_EFF_DT, BLDF.BLDF_TERM_DT, BLDF.BLDF_MCTR_STMT, BLDF.SYS_LAST_UPD_DTM  , BGBG.BGBG_ID,SBAD.SBAD_ADDR1,SBAD.SBAD_ADDR2,SBAD.SBAD_CITY,SBAD.SBAD_STATE,SBAD.SBAD_ZIP, BLDF.BLDF_MODE        FROM              FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR              JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB                  on GRGR.GRGR_CK = SBSB.GRGR_CK            JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSD_SPLT_DTL SBSD ON SBSB.SBSB_CK = SBSD.SBSB_CK AND SBSD_MCTR_STYP IN ('EMPL','FAML') AND SBSD_SPLT_PCT = 1000000 JOIN FACETS.CMC_BGBG_BIL_GROUP BGBG ON SBSD.BGBG_CK = BGBG.BGBG_CK JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI on BGBG.BGBG_CK = BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK and BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = 'B' JOIN Facets.CMC_BLDF_BL_DEFINE BLDF                  On BLDF.BLEI_Ck=BLEI.BLEI_CK         JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBAD_ADDR SBAD ON SBAD.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK  AND SBSB.SBAD_TYPE_MAIL = SBAD.SBAD_TYPE  WHERE  GRGR.GRGR_ID LIKE '%SUP%'  '

gv_RateExpirationCurrent.value: 'SELECT DISTINCT        'DTL' AS DETAIL,        NULL AS BGBG_ID,        NULL AS BGBG_NAME,        SBSB.SBSB_CK,        SBSB.SBSB_ID,        MEME.MEME_BIRTH_DT,        SBSD.SBSD_MCTR_STYP,        MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT,        MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT,        GRGR.GRGR_ID,        MEPE.CSCS_ID,        MEPE.CSPI_ID,        SBAD.SBAD_TYPE,        NULL AS ASM,        SBAD.SBAD_ADDR1 AS ADDR1,        SBAD.SBAD_ADDR2 AS ADDR2,        SBAD.SBAD_ADDR3 AS ADDR3,        SBAD.SBAD_CITY AS CITY,        SBAD.SBAD_STATE AS STATE,        SBAD.SBAD_ZIP AS ZIP,        TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS (SBSB.SBSB_ORIG_EFF_DT, 6),'YYYYMMDD') AS PREM_RATE_START_DT,        'N' AS NEW_ENROLL,        PLDS.PLDS_DESC,        MEME.MEME_FIRST_NAME,        MEME.MEME_LAST_NAME,        MEME.MEME_MID_INIT,         CASE             WHEN SUBSTR(MEPE.CSPI_ID,4,1) = 'A'             THEN '6MRGAA'             ELSE '6MRG'             END AS LETTER_TYPE,        NULL AS CSPI,        NULL AS PDRC   FROM FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB        INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME ON MEME.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK        INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR ON GRGR.GRGR_CK = SBSB.GRGR_CK        INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG MEPE           ON MEME.MEME_CK = MEPE.MEME_CK AND MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND = 'Y'        INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSD_SPLT_DTL SBSD           ON     SBSD.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK              AND SBSD.SBSD_MCTR_STYP NOT IN ('EMPL', 'FAML')        INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI           ON     BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK              AND BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = 'I'        INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBAD_ADDR SBAD           ON     SBAD.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK              AND SBSB.SBAD_TYPE_MAIL = SBAD.SBAD_TYPE        INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_PLDS_PLAN_DESC PLDS           ON MEPE.CSPI_ID = PLDS.CSPI_ID        INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_CSPI_CS_PLAN CSPI           ON CSPI.GRGR_CK = GRGR.GRGR_CK AND CSPI.CSPI_ID = PLDS.CSPI_ID        INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSR_SB_RATE SBSR ON SBSR.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK        INNER JOIN (SELECT GRGR_ID,                           CASE                              WHEN SUBSTR (GRGR_ID, 1, 2) IN ('GA', 'NY')                              THEN                                 TRUNC (TO_DATE('5/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')) + 65                              WHEN SUBSTR (GRGR_ID, 1, 2) IN ('NV')                              THEN                                 TRUNC (TO_DATE('5/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')) + 72                              WHEN SUBSTR (GRGR_ID, 3, 6) = 'SUP000'                              THEN                                 TRUNC (TO_DATE('5/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')) + 72                              WHEN SUBSTR (GRGR_ID, 1, 2) IN ('CA',                                                              'CO',                                                              'VA',                                                              'WI',                                                              'OH',                                                              'IN',                                                              'KY',                                                              'MO',                                                              'NH',                                                              'CT',                                                              'ME')                              THEN                                 TRUNC (TO_DATE('5/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')) + 35                           END                              AS RateLetterEligibledDt                      FROM FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP) DT           ON DT.GRGR_ID = GRGR.GRGR_ID  WHERE  CSPI.CSPI_GUAR_IND IN ('1', 'F')        AND SBSR.SBSR_EFF_DT >= MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT        AND TO_DATE (TO_CHAR (SBSR.SBSR_TERM_DT, 'MM/DD') || '/2196', 'MM/DD/YYYY') <= MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT        AND SBSR.PDBL_ID IN ('SCHG',                             'NEWE',                             'HH',                             'ANNU',                             'QTR',                             'SEMI',                             'EED')        AND GRGR.GRGR_ID LIKE '%SUP%'        AND DT.RateLetterEligibledDt = ADD_MONTHS (TRUNC (SBSB.SBSB_ORIG_EFF_DT), 6) UNION        SELECT DISTINCT        'DTL' AS DETAIL,        NULL AS BGBG_ID,        NULL AS BGBG_NAME,        SBSB.SBSB_CK,        SBSB.SBSB_ID,        MEME.MEME_BIRTH_DT,        SBSD.SBSD_MCTR_STYP,        MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT,        MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT,        GRGR.GRGR_ID,        MEPE.CSCS_ID,        MEPE.CSPI_ID,        SBAD.SBAD_TYPE,        NULL AS ASM,        SBAD.SBAD_ADDR1 AS ADDR1,        SBAD.SBAD_ADDR2 AS ADDR2,        SBAD.SBAD_ADDR3 AS ADDR3,        SBAD.SBAD_CITY AS CITY,        SBAD.SBAD_STATE AS STATE,        SBAD.SBAD_ZIP AS ZIP,               TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS (SBSB.SBSB_ORIG_EFF_DT, 6),'YYYYMMDD') AS PREM_RATE_START_DT,               'N' AS NEW_ENROLL,        PLDS.PLDS_DESC,        MEME.MEME_FIRST_NAME,        MEME.MEME_LAST_NAME,        MEME.MEME_MID_INIT,         CASE             WHEN SUBSTR(MEPE.CSPI_ID,4,1) = 'A'             THEN '6MRGAA'             ELSE '6MRG'             END AS LETTER_TYPE,        NULL AS CSPI,        NULL AS PDRC   FROM FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB        INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME ON MEME.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK        INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR ON GRGR.GRGR_CK = SBSB.GRGR_CK        INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG MEPE           ON MEME.MEME_CK = MEPE.MEME_CK AND MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND = 'Y'        INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSD_SPLT_DTL SBSD           ON     SBSD.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK              AND SBSD.SBSD_MCTR_STYP NOT IN ('EMPL', 'FAML')        INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI           ON     BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK              AND BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = 'I'        INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBAD_ADDR SBAD           ON     SBAD.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK              AND SBSB.SBAD_TYPE_MAIL = SBAD.SBAD_TYPE        INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_PLDS_PLAN_DESC PLDS           ON MEPE.CSPI_ID = PLDS.CSPI_ID        INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_CSPI_CS_PLAN CSPI           ON CSPI.GRGR_CK = GRGR.GRGR_CK AND CSPI.CSPI_ID = PLDS.CSPI_ID        INNER JOIN (SELECT GRGR_ID,                           CASE                              WHEN SUBSTR (GRGR_ID, 1, 2) IN ('GA', 'NY')                              THEN                                 TRUNC (TO_DATE('5/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')) + 65                              WHEN SUBSTR (GRGR_ID, 1, 2) IN ('NV')                              THEN                                 TRUNC (TO_DATE('5/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')) + 72                              WHEN SUBSTR (GRGR_ID, 3, 6) = 'SUP000'                              THEN                                 TRUNC (TO_DATE('5/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')) + 72                              WHEN SUBSTR (GRGR_ID, 1, 2) IN ('CA',                                                              'CO',                                                              'VA',                                                              'WI',                                                              'OH',                                                              'IN',                                                              'KY',                                                              'MO',                                                              'NH',                                                              'CT',                                                              'ME')                              THEN                                 TRUNC (TO_DATE('5/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')) + 35                           END                              AS RateLetterEligibledDt                      FROM FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP) DT           ON DT.GRGR_ID = GRGR.GRGR_ID  WHERE  CSPI.CSPI_GUAR_IND IN ('1', 'F')             AND GRGR.GRGR_ID LIKE '%SUP%'        AND DT.RateLetterEligibledDt = ADD_MONTHS (TRUNC (SBSB.SBSB_ORIG_EFF_DT), 6)'

gv_AUTO_REIN_OLD.value: 'SELECT DISTINCT 'DTL' AS DETAIL,NULL AS BGBG_ID,NULL AS BGBG_NAME, SBSB.SBSB_CK,SBSB.SBSB_ID,MEME.MEME_BIRTH_DT,SBSD.SBSD_MCTR_STYP,   MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT,MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT,   GRGR.GRGR_ID,MEPE.CSCS_ID,MEPE.CSPI_ID,SBAD.SBAD_TYPE,NULL AS ASM,   SBAD.SBAD_ADDR1  AS ADDR1,   SBAD.SBAD_ADDR2  AS ADDR2,   SBAD.SBAD_ADDR3  AS ADDR3,   SBAD.SBAD_CITY   AS CITY,   SBAD.SBAD_STATE  AS STATE,   SBAD.SBAD_ZIP    AS ZIP,   		 CASE WHEN SUBSTR(GRGR.GRGR_ID,1,2) IN ('GA','NY') THEN  			    					TO_CHAR(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM TO_DATE('4/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')+60)=1 THEN TO_DATE('4/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')+60  			 							ELSE TO_DATE(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE('4/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')+60,1))||'/'||'01'||'/'||EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE('4/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')+60,1)),'MM/DD/YYYY') END ,'YYYYMMDD')			         WHEN SUBSTR(GRGR.GRGR_ID,1,2) ='NV' THEN TO_CHAR(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM TO_DATE('4/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')+67)=1 THEN TO_DATE('4/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')+67  			 							ELSE TO_DATE(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE('4/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')+67,1))||'/'||'01'||'/'||EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE('4/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')+67,1)),'MM/DD/YYYY') END ,'YYYYMMDD')			          WHEN SUBSTR(GRGR.GRGR_ID,3,6) ='SUP000' THEN TO_CHAR(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM TO_DATE('4/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')+67)=1 THEN TO_DATE('4/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')+67  			 							ELSE TO_DATE(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE('4/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')+67,1))||'/'||'01'||'/'||EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE('4/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')+67,1)),'MM/DD/YYYY') END ,'YYYYMMDD')			         ELSE TO_CHAR(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM TO_DATE('4/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')+30)=1 THEN TO_DATE('4/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')+30  			 							ELSE TO_DATE(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE('4/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')+30,1))||'/'||'01'||'/'||EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE('4/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')+30,1)),'MM/DD/YYYY') END ,'YYYYMMDD')			          END AS PREM_RATE_START_DT,   CASE WHEN MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT-1 =  (SELECT MEPE_TERM_DT FROM FACETS.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG WHERE MEPE.MEME_CK = MEME_CK AND MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND = 'Y' AND TO_DATE('4/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy') BETWEEN MEPE_EFF_DT AND MEPE_TERM_DT)         THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS NEW_ENROLL,PLDS.PLDS_DESC, MEME.MEME_FIRST_NAME,MEME.MEME_LAST_NAME, MEME.MEME_MID_INIT,'AREIN' AS LETTER_TYPE,NULL AS CSPI,NULL AS PDRC,SBRT.SBRT_RT_AREA FROM   FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB   INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME     ON MEME.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK AND SBSB.SBSB_ID  IN (SELECT DISTINCT SUBSCRIBER_ID FROM AGP.AUTO_TERM_DELINQNT_REINSTMNT)   INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR     ON GRGR.GRGR_CK = SBSB.GRGR_CK   INNER JOIN (  SELECT GRGR_ID AS GRGR_ID, CASE WHEN SUBSTR(GRGR_ID,1,2) IN ('GA','NY') THEN  CASE WHEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM TO_DATE('4/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')+60)=1 THEN TO_DATE('4/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')+60  			 							ELSE TO_DATE(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE('4/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')+60,1))||'/'||'01'||'/'||EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE('4/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')+60,1)),'MM/DD/YYYY') END         WHEN SUBSTR(GRGR_ID,1,2) ='NV' THEN CASE WHEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM TO_DATE('4/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')+67)=1 THEN TO_DATE('4/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')+67  			 							ELSE TO_DATE(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE('4/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')+67,1))||'/'||'01'||'/'||EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE('4/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')+67,1)),'MM/DD/YYYY') END        WHEN SUBSTR(GRGR_ID,3,6) ='SUP000' THEN CASE WHEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM TO_DATE('4/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')+67)=1 THEN TO_DATE('4/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')+67  			 							ELSE TO_DATE(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE('4/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')+67,1))||'/'||'01'||'/'||EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE('4/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')+67,1)),'MM/DD/YYYY') END        ELSE CASE WHEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM TO_DATE('4/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')+30)=1 THEN TO_DATE('4/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')+30  			 							ELSE TO_DATE(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE('4/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')+30,1))||'/'||'01'||'/'||EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE('4/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')+30,1)),'MM/DD/YYYY') END END        AS DT       FROM FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP) DT ON DT.GRGR_ID = GRGR.GRGR_ID   INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG MEPE     ON MEME.MEME_CK = MEPE.MEME_CK         AND  DT.DT BETWEEN MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT AND MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT   INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSD_SPLT_DTL SBSD     ON SBSD.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK     INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI      ON BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK         AND BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = 'I'    INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBAD_ADDR SBAD     ON SBAD.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK      AND SBSB.SBAD_TYPE_MAIL = SBAD.SBAD_TYPE   INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_PLDS_PLAN_DESC PLDS     ON  MEPE.CSPI_ID=PLDS.CSPI_ID    LEFT OUTER JOIN              (             SELECT             DISTINCT             SBSB_CK             ,SBRT_EFF_DT            /* OVERLAPPING SBRT PERIOD IS CONVERTED TO NON OVER LAPPING */             ,CASE              WHEN SBRT_TERM_DT_2 IS NULL THEN SBRT_TERM_DT             WHEN SBRT_TERM_DT < SBRT_TERM_DT_2 THEN SBRT_TERM_DT             ELSE SBRT_TERM_DT_2             END AS SBRT_TERM_DT             ,SBRT_SMOKER_IND             ,SBRT_RT_AREA             FROM             (             SELECT /*+ INDEX_FFS(SRT) NO_BATCH_TABLE_ACCESS_BY_ROWID(SRT)*/             DISTINCT              SBSB_CK             ,SBRT_EFF_DT             ,SBRT_TERM_DT             ,CASE WHEN SBRT_SMOKER_IND IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE SBRT_SMOKER_IND END AS SBRT_SMOKER_IND             ,SBRT_RT_AREA             ,CASE              WHEN  SBRT_TERM_DT = LEAD(SBRT_EFF_DT-1) OVER(PARTITION BY SBSB_CK ORDER BY SBRT_EFF_DT, SBRT_TERM_DT) THEN SBRT_TERM_DT              ELSE LEAD(SBRT_EFF_DT-1) OVER(PARTITION BY SBSB_CK ORDER BY SBRT_EFF_DT, SBRT_TERM_DT)              END AS SBRT_TERM_DT_2             FROM FACETS.CMC_SBRT_RATE_DATA SRT             ) SRM             ) SBRT             ON SBRT.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK              AND             CASE              /* 1 DENOTES OVERLAPPING PERIODS, 0 DENOTES EXCLUSIVE PERIODS */             WHEN (MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT < SBRT.SBRT_EFF_DT) THEN 0             WHEN (MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT = SBRT.SBRT_EFF_DT) THEN 0             WHEN (MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT < SBRT.SBRT_EFF_DT AND MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT > SBRT.SBRT_EFF_DT AND MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT < SBRT.SBRT_TERM_DT) THEN 1             WHEN (MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT < SBRT.SBRT_EFF_DT AND MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT = SBRT.SBRT_TERM_DT) THEN 1             WHEN (MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT < SBRT.SBRT_EFF_DT AND MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT > SBRT.SBRT_TERM_DT) THEN 1             WHEN (MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT = SBRT.SBRT_EFF_DT AND MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT < SBRT.SBRT_TERM_DT) THEN 1             WHEN (MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT = SBRT.SBRT_EFF_DT AND MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT = SBRT.SBRT_TERM_DT) THEN 1             WHEN (MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT = SBRT.SBRT_EFF_DT AND MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT > SBRT.SBRT_TERM_DT) THEN 1             WHEN (MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT > SBRT.SBRT_EFF_DT AND MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT < SBRT.SBRT_TERM_DT) THEN 1             WHEN (MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT > SBRT.SBRT_EFF_DT AND MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT = SBRT.SBRT_TERM_DT) THEN 1             WHEN (MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT > SBRT.SBRT_EFF_DT AND MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT < SBRT.SBRT_TERM_DT AND MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT > SBRT.SBRT_TERM_DT) THEN 1             WHEN (MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT = SBRT.SBRT_TERM_DT) THEN 0             WHEN (MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT > SBRT.SBRT_TERM_DT) THEN 0             END = 1   WHERE GRGR.GRGR_ID LIKE '%SUP%' AND SBSD_MCTR_STYP NOT IN ('EMPL','FAML')'

TO_DATE('5/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')+67)=1 THEN TO_DATE('5/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')+67  			 							ELSE TO_DATE(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE('5/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')+67,1))||'/'||'01'||'/'||EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE('5/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')+67,1)),'MM/DD/YYYY') END ,'YYYYMMDD')			          WHEN ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE('5/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')+67,1))||'/'||'01'||'/'||EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE('5/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')+67,1)),'MM/DD/YYYY') END ,'YYYYMMDD')			         ELSE TO_CHAR(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM TO_DATE('5/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')+30)=1 THEN TO_DATE('5/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')+30  			 							ELSE TO_DATE(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE('5/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')+30,1))||'/'||'01'||'/'||EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE('5/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')+30,1)),'MM/DD/YYYY') END ,'YYYYMMDD')			          END AS PREM_RATE_START_DT,   CASE WHEN MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT-1 =  (SELECT MEPE_TERM_DT FROM FACETS.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG WHERE MEPE.MEME_CK = MEME_CK AND MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND = 'Y' AND TO_DATE('5/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy') BETWEEN MEPE_EFF_DT AND MEPE_TERM_DT)         THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS NEW_ENROLL,PLDS.PLDS_DESC, MEME.MEME_FIRST_NAME,MEME.MEME_LAST_NAME, MEME.MEME_MID_INIT,'AREIN' AS LETTER_TYPE,NULL AS CSPI,NULL AS PDRC ,SBRT.SBRT_RT_AREA FROM   FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB   INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME     ON MEME.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK AND SBSB.SBSB_ID  IN (SELECT DISTINCT SUBSCRIBER_ID FROM AGP.AUTO_TERM_DELINQNT_REINSTMNT)   INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR     ON GRGR.GRGR_CK = SBSB.GRGR_CK   INNER JOIN (  SELECT GRGR_ID AS GRGR_ID, CASE WHEN SUBSTR(GRGR_ID,1,2) IN ('GA','NY') THEN  CASE WHEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM TO_DATE('5/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')+60)=1 THEN TO_DATE('5/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')+60  			 							ELSE TO_DATE(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE('5/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')+60,1))||'/'||'01'||'/'||EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE('5/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')+60,1)),'MM/DD/YYYY') END         WHEN SUBSTR(GRGR_ID,1,2) ='NV' THEN CASE WHEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM TO_DATE('5/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')+67)=1 THEN TO_DATE('5/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')+67  			 							ELSE TO_DATE(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE('5/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')+67,1))||'/'||'01'||'/'||EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE('5/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')+67,1)),'MM/DD/YYYY') END        WHEN SUBSTR(GRGR_ID,3,6) ='SUP000' THEN CASE WHEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM TO_DATE('5/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')+67)=1 THEN TO_DATE('5/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')+67  			 							ELSE TO_DATE(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE('5/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')+67,1))||'/'||'01'||'/'||EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE('5/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')+67,1)),'MM/DD/YYYY') END        ELSE CASE WHEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM TO_DATE('5/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')+30)=1 THEN TO_DATE('5/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')+30  			 							ELSE TO_DATE(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE('5/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')+30,1))||'/'||'01'||'/'||EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE('5/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')+30,1)),'MM/DD/YYYY') END END        AS DT       FROM FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP) DT ON DT.GRGR_ID = GRGR.GRGR_ID   INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG MEPE     ON MEME.MEME_CK = MEPE.MEME_CK         AND  DT.DT BETWEEN MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT AND MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT   INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSD_SPLT_DTL SBSD     ON SBSD.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK     INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI      ON BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK         AND BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = 'I'    INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBAD_ADDR SBAD     ON SBAD.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK      AND SBSB.SBAD_TYPE_MAIL = SBAD.SBAD_TYPE   INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_PLDS_PLAN_DESC PLDS     ON  MEPE.CSPI_ID=PLDS.CSPI_ID         LEFT OUTER JOIN              (             SELECT             DISTINCT             SBSB_CK             ,SBRT_EFF_DT             /*OVERLAPPING SBRT PERIOD IS CONVERTED TO NON OVER LAPPING*/                        ,CASE              WHEN SBRT_TERM_DT_2 IS NULL THEN SBRT_TERM_DT             WHEN SBRT_TERM_DT < SBRT_TERM_DT_2 THEN SBRT_TERM_DT             ELSE SBRT_TERM_DT_2             END AS SBRT_TERM_DT             ,SBRT_SMOKER_IND             ,SBRT_RT_AREA             FROM             (             SELECT /*+ INDEX_FFS(SRT) NO_BATCH_TABLE_ACCESS_BY_ROWID(SRT)*/             DISTINCT              SBSB_CK             ,SBRT_EFF_DT             ,SBRT_TERM_DT             ,CASE WHEN SBRT_SMOKER_IND IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE SBRT_SMOKER_IND END AS SBRT_SMOKER_IND             ,SBRT_RT_AREA             ,CASE              WHEN  SBRT_TERM_DT = LEAD(SBRT_EFF_DT-1) OVER(PARTITION BY SBSB_CK ORDER BY SBRT_EFF_DT, SBRT_TERM_DT) THEN SBRT_TERM_DT              ELSE LEAD(SBRT_EFF_DT-1) OVER(PARTITION BY SBSB_CK ORDER BY SBRT_EFF_DT, SBRT_TERM_DT)              END AS SBRT_TERM_DT_2             FROM FACETS.CMC_SBRT_RATE_DATA SRT             ) SRM             ) SBRT             ON SBRT.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK              AND             CASE              /* 1 DENOTES OVERLAPPING PERIODS, 0 DENOTES EXCLUSIVE PERIODS */             WHEN (MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT < SBRT.SBRT_EFF_DT) THEN 0             WHEN (MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT = SBRT.SBRT_EFF_DT) THEN 0             WHEN (MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT < SBRT.SBRT_EFF_DT AND MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT > SBRT.SBRT_EFF_DT AND MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT < SBRT.SBRT_TERM_DT) THEN 1             WHEN (MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT < SBRT.SBRT_EFF_DT AND MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT = SBRT.SBRT_TERM_DT) THEN 1             WHEN (MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT < SBRT.SBRT_EFF_DT AND MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT > SBRT.SBRT_TERM_DT) THEN 1             WHEN (MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT = SBRT.SBRT_EFF_DT AND MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT < SBRT.SBRT_TERM_DT) THEN 1             WHEN (MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT = SBRT.SBRT_EFF_DT AND MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT = SBRT.SBRT_TERM_DT) THEN 1             WHEN (MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT = SBRT.SBRT_EFF_DT AND MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT > SBRT.SBRT_TERM_DT) THEN 1             WHEN (MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT > SBRT.SBRT_EFF_DT AND MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT < SBRT.SBRT_TERM_DT) THEN 1             WHEN (MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT > SBRT.SBRT_EFF_DT AND MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT = SBRT.SBRT_TERM_DT) THEN 1             WHEN (MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT > SBRT.SBRT_EFF_DT AND MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT < SBRT.SBRT_TERM_DT AND MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT > SBRT.SBRT_TERM_DT) THEN 1             WHEN (MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT = SBRT.SBRT_TERM_DT) THEN 0             WHEN (MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT > SBRT.SBRT_TERM_DT) THEN 0             END = 1   WHERE GRGR.GRGR_ID LIKE '%SUP%' AND SBSD_MCTR_STYP NOT IN ('EMPL','FAML')'

TRUNC(MEME.MEME_BIRTH_DT))||'/'||'01'||'/'||EXTRACT(YEAR FROM DT.DT) ,'MM/DD/YYYY')      ELSE ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM MEME.MEME_BIRTH_DT)||'/'||'01'||'/'||EXTRACT(YEAR FROM DT.DT) ,'MM/DD/YYYY'),1) END      WHEN BLDF.BLDF_MODE =1 THEN              CASE WHEN TO_DATE(BLDF.BLDF_SYNC_MO||'/'||'01'||'/'||EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE('5/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')) ,'MM/DD/YYYY')>=DT.DT                   THEN TO_DATE(BLDF.BLDF_SYNC_MO||'/'||'01'||'/'||EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE('5/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')) ,'MM/DD/YYYY')        ELSE ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(BLDF.BLDF_SYNC_MO||'/'||'01'||'/'||EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE('5/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')) ,'MM/DD/YYYY'),12) END            WHEN BLDF.BLDF_MODE=2 THEN             CASE WHEN TO_DATE(BLDF.BLDF_SYNC_MO||'/'||'01'||'/'||EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE('5/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')) ,'MM/DD/YYYY')>=DT.DT                   THEN TO_DATE(BLDF.BLDF_SYNC_MO||'/'||'01'||'/'||EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE('5/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')) ,'MM/DD/YYYY')             ELSE CASE WHEN ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(BLDF.BLDF_SYNC_MO||'/'||'01'||'/'||EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE('5/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')) ,'MM/DD/YYYY'),6)>=DT.DT                            THEN ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(BLDF.BLDF_SYNC_MO||'/'||'01'||'/'||EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE('5/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')) ,'MM/DD/YYYY'),6)                       ELSE CASE WHEN ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(BLDF.BLDF_SYNC_MO||'/'||'01'||'/'||EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE('5/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')) ,'MM/DD/YYYY'),12)>=DT.DT                                     THEN ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(BLDF.BLDF_SYNC_MO||'/'||'01'||'/'||EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE('5/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')) ,'MM/DD/YYYY'),12)                            END                       END                  END                                                                   WHEN BLDF.BLDF_MODE=4 THEN                CASE WHEN TO_DATE(BLDF.BLDF_SYNC_MO||'/'||'01'||'/'||EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE('5/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')) ,'MM/DD/YYYY')>=DT.DT                   THEN TO_DATE(BLDF.BLDF_SYNC_MO||'/'||'01'||'/'||EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE('5/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')) ,'MM/DD/YYYY')             ELSE CASE WHEN ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(BLDF.BLDF_SYNC_MO||'/'||'01'||'/'||EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE('5/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')) ,'MM/DD/YYYY'),3)>=DT.DT                            THEN ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(BLDF.BLDF_SYNC_MO||'/'||'01'||'/'||EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE('5/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')) ,'MM/DD/YYYY'),3)                       ELSE CASE WHEN ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(BLDF.BLDF_SYNC_MO||'/'||'01'||'/'||EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE('5/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')) ,'MM/DD/YYYY'),6)>=DT.DT                                     THEN ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(BLDF.BLDF_SYNC_MO||'/'||'01'||'/'||EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE('5/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')) ,'MM/DD/YYYY'),6)                            ELSE CASE WHEN ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(BLDF.BLDF_SYNC_MO||'/'||'01'||'/'||EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE('5/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')) ,'MM/DD/YYYY'),9)>=DT.DT                                     THEN ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(BLDF.BLDF_SYNC_MO||'/'||'01'||'/'||EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE('5/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')) ,'MM/DD/YYYY'),9)                                 ELSE CASE WHEN ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(BLDF.BLDF_SYNC_MO||'/'||'01'||'/'||EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE('5/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')) ,'MM/DD/YYYY'),12)>=DT.DT                                           THEN ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(BLDF.BLDF_SYNC_MO||'/'||'01'||'/'||EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE('5/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')) ,'MM/DD/YYYY'),12)                                      END                                 END                                 END                                                                                END                  END      END        WHEN CSPI.CSPI_AGE_CALC_METH = 'E' THEN     CASE            WHEN TO_DATE(TRUNC(CSPI.CSPI_REN_BEG_MMDD_NVL/100) || '/01/' || (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE('5/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy'))), 'mm/dd/yyyy')<TRUNC(DT.DT)            THEN TO_DATE(TRUNC(CSPI.CSPI_REN_BEG_MMDD_NVL/100) || '/01/' || (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE('5/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy'))+1), 'mm/dd/yyyy')           ELSE TO_DATE(TRUNC(CSPI.CSPI_REN_BEG_MMDD_NVL/100) || '/01/' || (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE('5/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy'))), 'mm/dd/yyyy')           END        END AS PREM_RATE_CURRENT_DT  FROM   FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB   INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME     ON MEME.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK    INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR     ON GRGR.GRGR_CK = SBSB.GRGR_CK AND (GRGR_ID LIKE '%SUP000' OR GRGR.GRGR_ID IN ('COSUPWP0','NVSUPWP0','WISUPWP0'))   INNER JOIN (  SELECT GRGR_ID AS GRGR_ID, CASE WHEN SUBSTR(GRGR_ID,1,2) ='NV' THEN CASE WHEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM TO_DATE('5/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')+67)=1 THEN TO_DATE('5/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')+67                                           ELSE TO_DATE(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE('5/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')+67,1))||'/'||'01'||'/'||EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE('5/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')+67,1)),'MM/DD/YYYY') END        WHEN SUBSTR(GRGR_ID,3,6) ='SUP000' THEN CASE WHEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM TO_DATE('5/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')+67)=1 THEN TO_DATE('5/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')+67                                           ELSE TO_DATE(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE('5/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')+67,1))||'/'||'01'||'/'||EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE('5/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')+67,1)),'MM/DD/YYYY') END        ELSE CASE WHEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM TO_DATE('5/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')+30)=1 THEN TO_DATE('5/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')+30                                           ELSE TO_DATE(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE('5/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')+30,1))||'/'||'01'||'/'||EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE('5/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy')+30,1)),'MM/DD/YYYY') END END        AS DT       FROM FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP) DT ON DT.GRGR_ID = GRGR.GRGR_ID   INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG MEPE     ON MEME.MEME_CK = MEPE.MEME_CK     AND MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND = 'Y'     AND  DT.DT BETWEEN MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT AND MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT   INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSD_SPLT_DTL SBSD  ON SBSD.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK     INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI      ON BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK         AND BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = 'I'    INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBAD_ADDR SBAD      ON SBAD.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK      AND SBSB.SBAD_TYPE_MAIL = SBAD.SBAD_TYPE   INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_PLDS_PLAN_DESC PLDS     ON  MEPE.CSPI_ID=PLDS.CSPI_ID     INNER JOIN CMC_CSPI_CS_PLAN CSPI     ON CSPI.GRGR_CK = GRGR.GRGR_CK AND CSPI.CSPI_ID = PLDS.CSPI_ID AND DT.DT BETWEEN CSPI.CSPI_EFF_DT AND CSPI.CSPI_TERM_DT         AND CSPI.CSPI_AGE_CALC_METH IN ('E','G')   INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLDF_BL_DEFINE BLDF      ON BLDF.BLEI_CK = BLEI.BLEI_CK AND DT.DT BETWEEN BLDF.BLDF_EFF_DT AND BLDF.BLDF_TERM_DT   WHERE GRGR.GRGR_ID LIKE '%SUP%' AND SBSD_MCTR_STYP NOT IN ('EMPL','FAML') ) SELECT DISTINCT SBSB_ID,PREM_RATE_CURRENT_DT,ADD_MONTHS(PREM_RATE_CURRENT_DT,-1) AS PREM_RATE_PREV_DT, CASE WHEN CSPI.CSPI_AGE_CALC_METH ='E'     THEN CASE            WHEN TO_DATE(TRUNC(CSPI.CSPI_REN_BEG_MMDD_NVL/100) || '/01/' || (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE('5/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy'))), 'mm/dd/yyyy')<TRUNC(C.PREM_RATE_CURRENT_DT)            THEN TO_DATE(TRUNC(CSPI.CSPI_REN_BEG_MMDD_NVL/100) || '/01/' || (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE('5/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy'))+1), 'mm/dd/yyyy')           ELSE TO_DATE(TRUNC(CSPI.CSPI_REN_BEG_MMDD_NVL/100) || '/01/' || (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE('5/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy'))), 'mm/dd/yyyy')           END    WHEN CSPI.CSPI_AGE_CALC_METH ='G'    THEN CASE            WHEN TO_DATE(TRUNC(CSPI.CSPI_OPEN_BEG_MMDD/100) || '/01/' || (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE('5/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy'))), 'mm/dd/yyyy')<TRUNC(C.PREM_RATE_CURRENT_DT)            THEN TO_DATE(TRUNC(CSPI.CSPI_OPEN_BEG_MMDD/100) || '/01/' || (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE('5/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy'))+1), 'mm/dd/yyyy')           ELSE TO_DATE(TRUNC(CSPI.CSPI_OPEN_BEG_MMDD/100) || '/01/' || (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE('5/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy'))), 'mm/dd/yyyy') END END AS CSPI_RENEW_DT,TRUNC(PDRC.PDRC_EFF_DT) AS PDRC_EFF_DT FROM CTE C INNER JOIN CMC_CSPI_CS_PLAN CSPI     ON CSPI.GRGR_CK = C.GRGR_CK AND CSPI.CSPI_ID = C.CSPI_ID AND C.PREM_RATE_CURRENT_DT BETWEEN CSPI.CSPI_EFF_DT AND CSPI.CSPI_TERM_DT         AND CSPI.CSPI_AGE_CALC_METH IN ('E','G')    INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_PDRT_RATE_TBL PDRT     ON PDRT.PDRT_MODIFIER = C.GRGR_ID||C.CSCS_ID|| C.CSPI_ID       AND C.PREM_RATE_CURRENT_DT BETWEEN PDRT.PDRT_EFF_DT AND PDRT.PDRT_TERM_DT   INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_PDRC_RATE_CAT PDRC     ON PDRC.PDRT_CK = PDRT.PDRT_CK      AND C.PREM_RATE_CURRENT_DT BETWEEN PDRC.PDRC_EFF_DT AND PDRC.PDRC_TERM_DT WHERE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM C.PREM_RATE_CURRENT_DT) = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM C.DT)    '

gv_BGBGQuery.value: 'select DISTINCT BGBG_CK, BGBG_ID, BGBG_NAME, BGBG_ADDR1, BGBG_ADDR2, BGBG_ADDR3, BGBG_CITY, BGBG_STATE, BGBG_ZIP, BGBG_COUNTY, BGBG_CTRY_CD, BGBG_PHONE, BGBG_PHONE_EXT, BGBG_EMAIL, BGBG_MCTR_TYPE, BGBG_ORIG_EFF_DT, BGBG_TERM_DT, BGBG_SPLT_BILL_IND    from CMC_BGBG_BIL_GROUP WHERE TO_DATE('5/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy') BETWEEN BGBG_ORIG_EFF_DT AND BGBG_TERM_DT'

gv_MEPEQuery.value: 'SELECT   SBSB.SBSB_ORIG_EFF_DT,SBSB.SBSB_FIRST_NAME,SBSB.SBSB_MID_INIT,SBSB.SBSB_LAST_NAME,SBSB.SBSB_CK,SBSB.SBSB_ID, MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT, MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT, MEPE.CSCS_ID, MEPE.GRGR_CK, MEPE.SGSG_CK, MEPE.CSPI_ID, MEPE.PDPD_ID,MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND, GRGR.GRGR_ID, PLDS.PLDS_DESC  FROM FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR	 JOIN CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB ON GRGR.GRGR_CK = SBSB.GRGR_CK         JOIN CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME ON MEME.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK         JOIN CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG MEPE ON MEPE.MEME_CK = MEME.MEME_CK   JOIN CMC_PLDS_PLAN_DESC PLDS ON PLDS.CSPI_ID = MEPE.CSPI_ID  WHERE   MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND = 'Y' AND TO_DATE('5/27/2022','mm/dd/yyyy') BETWEEN MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT AND MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT AND GRGR.GRGR_ID LIKE '%SUP%'   '

gv_BLDFQuery.value: 'SELECT    DISTINCT           SBSB.SBSB_CK,sbsb.sbsb_id, BLDF.BLEI_CK, BLDF.BLDF_EFF_DT, BLDF.BLDF_TERM_DT, BLDF.BLDF_MCTR_STMT, BLDF.SYS_LAST_UPD_DTM  , ' ' AS BGBG_ID ,SBAD.SBAD_ADDR1,SBAD.SBAD_ADDR2,SBAD.SBAD_CITY,SBAD.SBAD_STATE,SBAD.SBAD_ZIP, BLDF.BLDF_MODE      FROM              FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR              JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB                  on GRGR.GRGR_CK = SBSB.GRGR_CK             JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI                  on SBSB_CK = BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK                  and BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL=  'I'   AND BLEI.BLEI_SUSPND_BL_IND <> 'D'             JOIN Facets.CMC_BLDF_BL_DEFINE BLDF                  On BLDF.BLEI_Ck=BLEI.BLEI_CK          JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBAD_ADDR SBAD ON SBAD.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK  AND SBSB.SBAD_TYPE_MAIL = SBAD.SBAD_TYPE   WHERE BLDF.BLDF_MCTR_STMT NOT IN ('EMPL','FAML') AND GRGR.GRGR_ID LIKE '%SUP%' '
